title: getByIdOk
asserts: GET /api/visits/{id} for an existing visit returns 200 with id, description, petId.

title: getById_notFound
asserts: GET on an unknown visit id returns 404.

title: getAll
asserts: GET /api/visits includes a just-created visit by id and description.

title: getAll_returnsEnrichedFields
notes: Pre-existing; the same enrichment mechanism getAll_namesTheVetAndLeavesUnattendedVisitsEmpty extends with vet fields, but this test itself asserts nothing about the vet.

title: create_invalid
asserts: POST with no description is rejected 400.

title: update_invalid
asserts: PUT that nulls the description is rejected 4xx.

title: delete_ok
asserts: DELETE removes a visit; a subsequent GET 404s.

title: delete_notFound
asserts: DELETE on an unknown visit id returns 404.

title: create_ok
asserts: POST with a description (no vet involved) is created and persisted.

title: update_ok
asserts: PUT changes date and description; persisted.
notes: The test-changes manifest flags this 'modified', but it is byte-identical to origin/main (diff shows no hunk touching it) — it only shifted line numbers because @BeforeEach grew above it. Recorded here as unchanged in substance.

title: create_withoutVet_leavesItUnassigned
asserts: POST with no vetId still succeeds (201) and the persisted visit's vet is null.

title: create_withVet_recordsWhoAttends
asserts: POST with a vetId returns 201 and the persisted visit's vet is that vet.

title: bookingUnderTheOwnerRecordsTheVet
asserts: POST /api/owners/{id}/pets/{id}/visits with a vetId also records the vet.
notes: #37: the owner-scoped booking endpoint gets the same vet-recording behaviour as the flat one (s1, s3).

title: create_unknownVet_notFound
asserts: POST with a vetId that does not exist in the roster is rejected 404, not silently accepted.
notes: #37: closes the referential-integrity gap the previous implementation left open (s1).

title: update_assignsTheVet
asserts: PUT with a vetId assigns/changes the attending vet on an existing visit.

title: getAll_namesTheVetAndLeavesUnattendedVisitsEmpty
asserts: GET /api/visits returns vetId/vetFirstName/vetLastName for an attended visit, and all three null for an unattended one.
notes: #37: display data at the API layer (s1, s2), and the only evidence — exercised, not targeted — for s12 (pre-existing visits keep no vet). Line shifted from :338 to :318 — 6aac04b4 removed update_withoutVet_clearsTheOneOnFile (formerly :319), the test that had asserted s5/s6's 'can remove it' claim; nothing now covers it.

title: findVisitsByPetId
asserts: Repository method findByPetId returns every visit for a pet.
